Also—this is embarrassing to admit—but my uniform is feeling tighter and it messes with my head before a turn. I’m not asking for anything extreme, I just want to feel put-together and not spiral. No judgment, please.

About the uniform feeling tighter—I’m not judging at all. It’s okay to feel off, and you’re not alone in that. Instead of spiraling, focus on one small, kind step: maybe a quick stretch or a moment to acknowledge all your body does for you during these tough shifts.
